text:
elaine: forwarding an escalated customer (AcmeSearch). They hit an embeddings rerank flow that intermittently returns a dimension mismatch (400) when batching 3-5 items. Also seeing 401s after ~200 requests from their client, and rerank latency spikes to 2.5s intermittently. attaching initial req ids and a quick curl to reproduce.

elaine: Request IDs: r_01G8YwX1a2b3c4d5, r_01G8YwX1a2b3c4d6 (timestamps approx 2025-11-02T14:12:03Z, 2025-11-02T14:13:01Z). Customer says failures happen in bursts.

diego: can you paste the exact curl + payload they used? and which model/region + SDK version?

elaine: they use model "embed-14-large" in us-west, via our hosted API (api.redwood.com). SDK v0.9.2 and a custom wrapper. Here's the curl they sent (redacted key):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \
  --data-binary @payload.gz
```

payload (uncompressed shown):
```
{
  "model": "embed-14-large",
  "inputs": [
    "short query",
    "a much longer document that should be ok",
    "mid-size text"
  ]
}
```

elaine: customer says when they POST uncompressed JSON it usually works; failure more common when they gzip batches. Also their rerank call (separate endpoint) is a POST with body shape `{"queries": [...], "candidates": [...]}"` and that call times out or spikes.

natalie_support: 401s + bursts could be token rotation / ephemeral token issue or client reusing expired token. Can we check auth logs for those request ids? also ask customer to confirm system clock and retry-after headers. :eyes:

sam_sre: pulling server traces now for r_01G8YwX1a2b3c4d5 and r_01G8YwX1a2b3c4d6. initial look: we saw an auth rejection from edge at T+0.2s then a retry that succeeded, then a downstream embedding handler returning a dimension mismatch at T+0.5s.

sam_sre: dimension mismatch usually means payload shape expected as a list of strings but got nested arrays after decompress or a corrupted gzip stream. can you ask customer to supply raw base64/gzip payload or replay with --data-binary to stdout so we can inspect?

support-bot: incident created INC-4521 and linked to ticket #ACME-1187.

crm_engineer: we fetched auth logs for their API key. There are ~210 auth attempts across a minute, with intermittent 401s clustered at token refresh windows. Also noticed their client container had clock skew of ~65s in logs (ntp not running). That explains auth TTL mismatches. sending hint to customer to sync time.

diego: regarding the embedding shape: I suspect their gzip wrapper is double-encoding arrays. Ask them to try this minimal failing vs. corrected examples:

Failing payload (client mistake):
```
{
  "model": "embed-14-large",
  "inputs": [["short query"], ["a much longer document"], ["mid-size text"]]
}
```
Correct payload:
```
{
  "model": "embed-14-large",
  "inputs": ["short query", "a much longer document", "mid-size text"]
}
```

diego: also ask them to remove Content-Encoding header (or ensure gzip stream valid). We see a few streams with CRC errors in decompressor before parse which can flip dimensionality when decoder misreads separators.

elaine: I pinged customer for: (1) raw gzip they POST (base64 ok), (2) exact client clock/time, (3) SDK logs with request ids, (4) a replay attempt with this explicit curl:
```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"model":"embed-14-large","inputs":["a","b","c"]}'
```

elaine: and asked them to run the gzipped variant with --data-binary to capture exact bytes: `--data-binary @payload.gz` so we can diff.

sam_sre: next steps from infra: if customer provides base64 gzip we will run the decompression locally and feed the raw bytes into our parsing pipeline to reproduce. I'll queue a server-side trace and ask infra to preserve worker logs for the timeframe.

natalie_support: also request their client threadpool size and batching logic. They mentioned auto-batch threshold at 5 and manual flushes. that could create hybrid batches with mixed shapes if wrapper concatenates JSON fragments incorrectly.

crm_engineer: I'll include a short suggested checklist for customer to try while we wait: sync clock (ntp/systemd-timesyncd), remove or validate Content-Encoding, try uncompressed replay, confirm SDK v0.9.2 vs latest, send base64 of failing payload, and include exact request ids.

diego: I can prepare a small playback harness for them to run locally (node/python) that mimics our boundary conditions (gzip + concurrent requests) and will post to the ticket.

elaine: thanks — I'm waiting on their artifacts. tagging @sam_sre and @diego to keep as owners for traces + playback. will update ticket when we have the base64.gz. :thumbsup:

natalie_support: great, I'll keep customer updated and set expectation 48h for full reproducible bundle. marking as high-priority.

sam_sre: got the debug bundle queued (bundle id dbg_88f1). once customer uploads base64.gz to the ticket I'll pull and run decompression + parser fuzz.

elaine: closing loop for now. if anyone picks up earlier, ping in thread. thanks.
